segments.text: This is Dogear. A PDF reader for studying, made for Omarchy.

segments.caption: Your library
segments.text: Every PDF you open goes into your library. Sort it, search it, and file each one under a category, one for every class.

segments.caption: Reading
segments.text: Reading is quiet and quick. Scroll with the wheel, or with J and K. Dogear remembers where you stopped, in every file.

segments.caption: Highlights and notes
segments.text: Select a passage and press a number to highlight it, in one of five colors. Click a highlight to add a note, and hover over it later to read the note again.

segments.caption: Answer lines
segments.text: Worksheets have blanks. Just click one and type. There's no text box to place: Dogear finds the answer lines on the page, and Tab takes you to the next one.

segments.caption: Outline, bookmarks, search
segments.text: The sidebar holds the outline, your highlights, bookmarks and notes. Press B to bookmark a page, and slash to search the whole document.

segments.caption: Markdown export
segments.text: When it's time to review, export it all to Markdown.
Your highlights and notes come out page by page, with each answer under its question, ready for Obsidian.

segments.caption: One folder, every computer
segments.text: Search the library, and it finds words inside your notes too. Everything lives in one folder: point Dogear at a folder you sync, with Syncthing, Dropbox or Google Drive, and every computer has the same library.
Dogear is free and open source, from Nine Point Labs. Get it at dogear dot ninepointlabs dot com.
